afterFileEdit.command: test -f .cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh && exec .cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh afterFileEdit; test -f ./hooks/impeccable.sh && exec ./hooks/impeccable.sh afterFileEdit; test -f ./impeccable.sh && exec ./impeccable.sh afterFileEdit; root=`git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null`; test -f "$root/.cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh" && exec "$root/.cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh" afterFileEdit; exit 127

stop.command: test -f .cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh && exec .cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh stop; test -f ./hooks/impeccable.sh && exec ./hooks/impeccable.sh stop; test -f ./impeccable.sh && exec ./impeccable.sh stop; root=`git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null`; test -f "$root/.cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh" && exec "$root/.cursor/hooks/impeccable.sh" stop; exit 127
